acceptance: With the real PlatformOptimizationConfiguration, a tuned Spark run sets each requested key on the session and records one executed PHASE_SESSION ledger statement per key.
Fresh-database and reused-database runs (including the enable_hive reuse path) produce the same applied_ledger_hash and the same live session state.
A tuned `spark.sql.adaptive.enabled: false` is still false after configure_for_benchmark.
notuning runs apply no tuning keys.
A tuning key that conflicts with an explicit adapter option wins and is reported; a key refused by the engine is recorded as failed and warned, not applied.
get_platform_info matches the live session for tuned keys.
uv run -- pytest tests/unit/platforms/test_spark_helpers.py -q passes using the real dataclass.
context:
Origin: user-approved 2026-09-30 (see spark-session-config-model). Opus review findings C2, R3, R4 drive this item. Precedence rule is the user's own wording: "tuning file beats everything except user overrides configured outside of benchbox". Interpretation to confirm with user if it matters in implementation: a non-enforced external default (e.g. spark-defaults.conf) is overridden by a runtime conf.set and reported as a discrepancy by the preflight-capture item; only enforced external settings win. Verified: `--platform-option spark_config=...` is rejected for spark, velox and lakesail, so spark_config has no CLI route today. Pitfall: the CLI default --shuffle-partitions 200 is indistinguishable from an explicit value, which no longer matters because the tuning file wins either way.

2026-10-13 review note (origin/develop 77048bfb9): 250d92252 (#2876) shipped the validated spark map but not this item's runtime design. On a reused database the map is never applied (reuse path result_capture.py ~L1327 skips apply_unified_tuning; spark keys are deliberately excluded from the drift marker, metadata.py ~L240), yet the result records it and reports a session_config tuning type. On fresh runs configure_for_benchmark (spark.py ~L522 -> _spark_helpers.py ~L55-60) later resets AQE/CBO keys from the adapter's spark_config while the ledger says EXECUTED. Validation weaknesses are tracked separately in spark-session-config-map-validation-20261013.
description:
Make `platform_optimizations.spark` take effect on native Spark. Today `SparkLikeAdapterMixin.apply_platform_optimizations` (benchbox/platforms/_spark_helpers.py ~L473-505) has a `spark` branch that is unreachable with the production dataclass (tests use a dummy object), prepends `spark.` to keys that may already be qualified, and logs "platform optimizations applied" unconditionally. Prior art (extend): `_record_spark_conf_ledger` (_spark_helpers.py ~L523) and the cloud capture in benchbox/platforms/base/cloud_spark/mixins.py ~L261 (PHASE_SESSION, mechanism spark_session_config).

Design:
- Apply in exactly one place: `SparkAdapter.configure_for_benchmark` (spark.py ~L659), gated on `self.tuning_enabled`, AFTER the OLAP defaults. configure_for_benchmark runs on both fresh and reused databases (adapter.py ~L1039), whereas apply_unified_tuning (~L1553) runs only on a fresh database and before configure_for_benchmark, which resets AQE/CBO and would silently undo a tuned value the ledger already called applied. apply_platform_optimizations must skip `spark`. Consequence to document: data load runs with untuned session settings.
- Precedence (user decision 2026-09-30): the tuning file beats everything configured inside BenchBox (built-in defaults and explicit adapter options such as spark_config / --shuffle-partitions). Only an override enforced OUTSIDE BenchBox wins (cluster-locked or immutable settings, a managed service refusing the change). Do not try to defeat external enforcement. A tuning key that shadows an explicit BenchBox adapter option is logged and recorded so the user sees it.
- Before each set call `spark.conf.isModifiable(key)` where the API exists (treat absence, e.g. on Spark Connect engines, as "attempt the set"). A key that is refused or does not read back as requested is recorded as failed and surfaced loudly (WARNING plus bundle), never as applied. Detailed read-back and discrepancy reporting belongs to spark-effective-config-preflight-capture; this item must expose the hooks it needs.
- Record each applied tuning key as an executed PHASE_SESSION statement with the canonical key and lower-cased value; record exactly once per run so applied_ledger_hash is the same for fresh and reused databases.
- get_platform_info (spark.py ~L376-398) reports configured self.shuffle_partitions/self.adaptive_enabled, not live values; make result metadata agree with the tuned session.
- Replace the dummy-object tests with the real dataclass; delete the unconditional success log.
